atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeLookback = input(50, "Range Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThreshold = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
predictThreshold = input(50, "Predictability Threshold", 10, 90, 1)
expansionMult = input(1.5, "Expansion Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
tr = max(tr1, tr2)
tr = max(tr, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
cMax = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
cMin = lowest(atrVal, coilLookback)
denom = cMax - cMin
coilLoad = denom > 0 ? 100 * (1 - (atrVal - cMin) / denom) : 0
rangeLow = lowest(rng, rangeLookback)
contracted = rng <= 1.1 * rangeLow
atrMean = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrMean > 0 ? atrSd / atrMean * 100 : 0
vovRising = vov > vov[1] and vov > vov[2]
sCh = close - close[1]
aCh = abs(sCh)
sumS = sma(sCh, predictLen) * predictLen
sumA = sma(aCh, predictLen) * predictLen
predict = sumA > 0 ? 100 * abs(sumS) / sumA : 0
loaded = coilLoad >= coilThreshold and contracted and vovRising
loadedPred = loaded and predict >= predictThreshold
loadedUnpred = loaded and predict < predictThreshold
rangeExpands = rng > expansionMult * atrVal and (close > high[1] or close < low[1])
rawBuy = loaded[1] and rng > expansionMult * atrVal and close > open and close > high[1]
rawSell = loaded[1] and rng > expansionMult * atrVal and close < open and close < low[1]
buySig = rawBuy and not rawBuy[1]
sellSig = rawSell and not rawSell[1]

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(predict, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
bgcolor(loadedPred ? "#0e3b2e" : loadedUnpred ? "#3b2a0e" : loaded ? "#1a2a3b" : "#101018", "separate")

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length (bars)", 5, 200, 1)
htfLen = input(20, "1H Lookback for Structure (bars)", 5, 200, 1)
confBars = input(2, "Structure Confirmation Bars", 1, 10, 1)
confLook = input(10, "Confidence Lookback (bars)", 2, 100, 1)
stopDist = input(15, "Hard Stop Distance (ticks/points)", 1, 200, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
rng = sessHigh - sessLow
rngSafe = rng == 0 ? 0.000000001 : rng

h1High = security("1h", highest(high, htfLen))
h1Low = security("1h", lowest(low, htfLen))
h1Close = security("1h", close)

var bullN = 0
var bearN = 0
var dir = 0
var entryPx = 0.0

bullHold = close > h1High
bearHold = close < h1Low
if bullHold {
    bullN := bullN + 1
} else {
    bullN := 0
}
if bearHold {
    bearN := bearN + 1
} else {
    bearN := 0
}
bullAgree = bullN >= confBars
bearAgree = bearN >= confBars

upDisp = h1Close - h1High
dnDisp = h1Low - h1Close
rawQ = upDisp > 0 ? upDisp / rngSafe * 100 : dnDisp > 0 ? dnDisp / rngSafe * 100 : 0
qualHi = rawQ > 100 ? 100 : rawQ
qualClamped = qualHi < 0 ? 0 : qualHi
confVal = highest(qualClamped, confLook)
conf01 = confVal / 100

stopLong = entryPx - stopDist
stopShort = entryPx + stopDist
activeStop = dir == 1 ? stopLong : dir == -1 ? stopShort : close

sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]
buySig = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) and bullAgree and dir != 1
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) and bearAgree and dir != -1
longStopHit = dir == 1 and low <= activeStop
shortStopHit = dir == -1 and high >= activeStop
longBreakExit = dir == 1 and crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
shortBreakExit = dir == -1 and crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
longExitSig = longStopHit or longBreakExit
shortExitSig = shortStopHit or shortBreakExit

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    dir := 1
    entryPx := close
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    dir := -1
    entryPx := close
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longExitSig {
    model.exit("siege")
    dir := 0
    entryPx := close
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "L Exit", "triangledown", "#ffcc00")
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.exit("siege")
    dir := 0
    entryPx := close
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "S Exit", "triangleup", "#ffcc00")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(activeStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")

wz = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wind_speed_knots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
min_speed_knots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 1.0)
max_speed_knots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 1.0, 150.0, 1.0)

markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

ax = wx < 0 ? 0 - wx : wx
ay = wy < 0 ? 0 - wy : wy
az = wz < 0 ? 0 - wz : wz
magAbs = ax + ay + az
denomYaw = ax + ay + 0.000000001
fracYaw = ay / denomYaw
yawQ1 = 90 * fracYaw
yawQ2 = 180 - 90 * fracYaw
yawQ3 = 0 - 180 + 90 * fracYaw
yawQ4 = 0 - 90 * fracYaw
yawRaw = wx >= 0 ? (wy >= 0 ? yawQ1 : yawQ4) : (wy >= 0 ? yawQ2 : yawQ3)
horiz = ax + ay + 0.000000001
denomPitch = az + horiz + 0.000000001
pitchRaw = 90 * wz / denomPitch
rollRaw = 0.0
yaw = magAbs == 0 ? yaw[1] : yawRaw
pitch = magAbs == 0 ? pitch[1] : pitchRaw
roll = rollRaw
gust = change(close)
windDyn = wind_speed_knots + gust
alertLine = high_wind_alert_knots
tailRaw = base_arrow_length + length_per_knot * windDyn
tailLen = tailRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : tailRaw
spanRaw = max_speed_knots - min_speed_knots
spanSafe = spanRaw == 0 ? 1.0 : spanRaw
normRaw = (windDyn - min_speed_knots) / spanSafe
speed_norm = normRaw < 0 ? 0 : (normRaw > 1 ? 1 : normRaw)
gradColor = speed_norm > 0.75 ? "#ff8800" : (speed_norm > 0.5 ? "#cc6a33" : (speed_norm > 0.25 ? "#5577cc" : "#2255ff"))
coneRaw = tailLen * markerSize
coneSz = coneRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : (coneRaw > 3.0 ? 3.0 : coneRaw)
buySig = windDyn > alertLine and windDyn[1] <= alertLine
sellSig = windDyn < alertLine and windDyn[1] >= alertLine

}
if sellSig {

}
if buySig {

}
